name: Web Disability Simulator
summary: Adds filter-based simulations of how a page renders for several disability types (color blindness, low vision, dyslexia-style effects) so designers can spot perception problems.
browsersNote: No Firefox or Edge listing found on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Experiencing how filters change a page for people with low vision, color blindness or dyslexia-style effects.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: disability simulator color blindness low vision dyslexia filter accessibility
